_meta.note: Starter set of common SAC/HSN codes for Indian freelancers, compiled from publicly published CBIC GST rate schedules. GST rates change periodically — verify against CBIC (cbic-gst.gov.in) before relying on this for a real filing. Run 'Check for GST Rate Table Updates' from the main menu to pull the latest version of this file from the project's GitHub repo.
